article.story: HIGH POINT, N.C. -- — Cam'Ron Fletcher's 24 points helped High Point defeat Mary Baldwin 129-47 on Tuesday. Fletcher also contributed seven rebounds and four steals for the Panthers (9-3). Chase Johnston shot 5 for 10 from beyond the arc to add 15 points. Vincent Brady II finished with 14 points. Rony Hogarth led the Fighting Squirrels in scoring, finishing with 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
